name: DelegationOfAuthorityMatrix
tagline: A delegation of authority (DoA) says who may approve which kind of document up to which amount.
description: A delegation of authority (DoA) says who may approve which kind of document up to which amount. The Delegation of Authority Matrix shows those rules as a grid of roles and document types, checks them for problems, and answers the everyday question "Who has to approve this?" for any amount.
features: Roles x document types grid with limit ranges
Coverage checks (gaps from zero to a top authority, overlapping limits at the same level)
A Who approves? simulator that highlights the approval chain for an amount
Document-type / business-unit / state filters, issues view
Multi-select with Edit / Extend / Suspend actions
A phone accordion layout and Power Fx outputs and events
